newsitem.title: USA: Children's Discovery expects strong net.
newsitem.headline: Children's Discovery expects strong net.

text.p: Following an increase in first quarter earnings, Children's Discovery Centers of America Inc said Thursday it expects continued favorable earnings results in future periods.

Children's Discovery, which is one of the nation's largest private school companies, said growth in 1997 will come from the acquisition of new schools, the development of employer management agreements, and continued expansion of the company's private elementary school programs.
In the first quarter, the company earned $525,000 or $0.08 per share on revenues of $22.6 million, compared to $466,000 or $0.07 per share on revenues of $21.1 million last year.
